subject: Intro: Hosted API evaluation — pick preferred slot & sandbox access
content:
From: Alex Chen <alex@cartline.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Quick hosted API eval — request for 45m sandbox session

Hi Neha,

We signed up for the hosted API trial this morning (thanks for making it easy). My team is evaluating generator throughput and cost at 1k-2k reqs/day — we'd like a 45-minute sandbox walkthrough this week if possible. Primary goals: get the sandbox invite, test streaming responses, and validate token costs for our 1:1 chat flow.

We can do: Friday 4/23 10:00am PDT or Monday 4/26 9:00am PDT. Attendees: me (Alex), Priya (engineering lead, priya@cartline.ai), and Maya (product).

Also, can you share SOC 2 summary and any quick notes on data retention for hosted API?

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Chen
Head of ML Engineering, Cartline AI
alex@cartline.ai

-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@cartline.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API eval — request for 45m sandbox session

Hi Alex — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood!

Thanks for the windows. Friday 4/23 10:00am PDT works for our on-call PLG engineer. We typically run a 30–45m session: quick walkthrough of the hosted API endpoints, streaming demo, then we open the sandbox for you to run a couple of payloads with live monitoring.

Action items before the session:
- Confirm final attendee list (names + emails)
- Share a brief sample prompt and target sequence length (so we pre-seed the KV cache)
- Let us know if you need a private sandbox link (yes/no) or fine with the shared trial workspace

I'll loop in Diego (CS) to provision a private sandbox link and attach the SOC2 one-pager. If you prefer Monday instead, say the word and we'll swap.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
SDR, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

-----
From: Alex Chen <alex@cartline.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@cartline.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API eval — request for 45m sandbox session

Thanks Neha — Friday 4/23 10:00am PDT is perfect. Attendees confirmed: Alex (alex@cartline.ai), Priya Rao (priya@cartline.ai), Maya Singh (maya@cartline.ai).

Sample prompt: conversational customer support snippets (~40 tokens average reply, up to 120 tokens for escalation).

Private sandbox invite would be ideal — we want to keep traffic separated from other trials. SOC2 one-pager would be great to have before the call.

See you Friday,
Alex

-----
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@cartline.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API eval — request for 45m sandbox session

Hi Alex — Diego from Customer Success here. I've provisioned a private sandbox and sent the invite link below. Invite contains a preloaded sample dataset and a 48-hour private token.

Sandbox link: https://redwood.example.com/sandbox/abcd1234
Invite token: (sent in separate secure message)

Attached: cartline_sow.pdf (SOW draft — internal), sandbox-invite.txt (invite metadata).

I'll be on the call Friday to walk through perf dashboard and token breakdowns. Quick note on SOC2: attaching the one-pager now — the full report is available under NDA; happy to start that cadence if you need it for procurement.

See you Friday 10:00am PDT.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
